activation_checklist: written terms for storage and derived-model use
GSIS crosswalk check on a QB sample
dry run on a past week with synthetic clock
owner approves a protocol before any score is computed
authorization: The plan activates only after (1) the repository owner authorizes the specific source and terms, and (2) a vendor trial passes the acceptance harness. This phase starts no collection.

T24.content: depth chart (QB slots), injury report with practice status, roster status, recent transactions
T24.window: capture starts at T24 - 10 minutes and must complete before T24; a capture completing after T24 is stored as LATE and is invisible to state_at(T24)

T90.content: all of T24 plus active/inactive list
T90.window: capture starts at T90 - 10 minutes and must complete before T90; inactives become public about T-90 and are expected to arrive after a provider lag, so T90 inactives need explicit lag receipts

capture_schedule.between_cutoffs: optional hourly captures (Sportradar guidance: pull every hour or less) create the revision sequence; none may be backdated

confidence_state.rule: confidence stays null unless a registered certification rule passes; no probability is derived from depth rank
confidence_state.states: canonical STATE_TYPES; MULTI_QB or UNCERTAIN_STARTER whenever visible rows disagree or none exist

hashes.batch_manifest: sha256 over the ordered hashes of a capture group

immutability.corrections: a correction is a new revision row
immutability.storage: append-only files or an immutable object store; files are written once and then marked read-only; a store verifier recomputes hashes

leakage_controls: no target-game participation field may populate a pregame row
postgame_only_flag rows are excluded by construction
game-day starters, snap counts and box scores are evaluation labels only

rules: one normalized row per (source record, revision) with revision_sequence
raw_source_hash links to the raw layer
as_of_certified only when a registered certification rule passes
postgame_only/backfilled rows are stored but never visible to state_at
never overwrite a prior capture; a changed payload is a NEW capture with a new hash
published_at is stored only when the provider supplies it; otherwise null (never inferred)
retrieved_at is our clock at the last received byte (UTC)
store request URL (without secrets), HTTP status and response headers needed for audit

revision_handling.provider_retracts: a retraction is a new row (valid_to set on the superseded interval), not a deletion
revision_handling.state_at: returns the highest revision visible at the cutoff; later revisions never leak backward

scope: A clean-forward collection plan for future games. No future outcome is read or scored, no scheduler/production file is changed, no unauthorized recurring scraping is started.

forbidden: any outcome or postgame starter labels as features

primary_forward_candidate.mechanism: existing repository forward snapshots (HTTP GET of public GitHub release assets, sha256 recorded); Phase 1M adds no new collector
primary_forward_candidate.note: dt is a load time; our retrieved_at is the only timestamp that proves what was knowable
primary_forward_candidate.provider: nflverse depth_charts_{season} (2025+ format with dt) and injuries_{season}

vendor_acceptance_track.mechanism: poll Weekly Depth Charts, Weekly Injuries, Game Roster and Daily Change Log at the schedule below; store every payload; only after a written acceptance run

timestamps.visibility: record visible at a cutoff only if retrieval_timestamp <= cutoff (and publication <= cutoff when present)
